1.english_reference: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon [ and ] against the land of the Chaldeans

traditions.WLC: הַ דָּבָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֧ר יְהוָ֛ה אֶל בָּבֶ֖ל אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֑ים
traditions.VUL: Verbum , quod locútus est Dóminus de Babylóne et de terra Chaldæórum ,
traditions.KJV: The word that the LORD spake against Babylon [ and ] against the land of the Chaldeans
by Jeremiah the prophet .

2.english_reference: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard ;

traditions.WLC: הַגִּ֨ידוּ בַ גּוֹיִ֤ם וְ הַשְׁמִ֨יעוּ֙ וּֽ שְׂאוּ נֵ֔ס
traditions.VUL: Annuntiáte in géntibus , et audítum fácite : leváte signum ,
traditions.KJV: Declare ye among the nations , and publish , and set up a standard ;
publish , [ and ] conceal not :
say , Babylon is taken ,

2.english_reference: Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces ;

traditions.VUL: confúsus est Bel , victus est Mérodach ,
traditions.KJV: Bel is confounded , Merodach is broken in pieces ;

2.english_reference: her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .

traditions.WLC: הֹבִ֣ישׁוּ עֲצַבֶּ֔י הָ חַ֖תּוּ גִּלּוּלֶֽי הָ
traditions.VUL: confúsa sunt sculptília eius , superáta sunt idóla eórum .
traditions.KJV: her idols are confounded , her images are broken in pieces .

3.english_reference: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her ,

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י עָלָה֩ עָלֶ֨י הָ גּ֜וֹי מִ צָּפ֗וֹן
traditions.VUL: Quóniam ascéndit contra eam gens ab aquilóne ,
traditions.KJV: For out of the north there cometh up a nation against her ,

3.english_reference: which shall make her land desolate ,

traditions.WLC: הֽוּא יָשִׁ֤ית אֶת אַרְצָ הּ֙ לְ שַׁמָּ֔ה
traditions.VUL: quæ ponet terram eius in solitúdinem :
traditions.KJV: which shall make her land desolate ,

traditions.WLC: וְ לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה יוֹשֵׁ֖ב בָּ֑ הּ
traditions.VUL: et non erit qui hábitet in ea
traditions.KJV: and none shall dwell therein :

3.english_reference: they shall remove , they shall depart , both man and beast .

traditions.WLC: מֵ אָדָ֥ם וְ עַד בְּהֵמָ֖ה נָ֥דוּ הָלָֽכוּ
traditions.VUL: ab hómine usque ad pecus : et moti sunt , et abiérunt .
traditions.KJV: they shall remove , they shall depart , both man and beast .

4.english_reference: In those days , and in that time , saith the LORD ,

traditions.WLC: בַּ יָּמִ֨ים הָ הֵ֜מָּה וּ בָ עֵ֤ת הַ הִיא֙ נְאֻם יְהוָ֔ה
traditions.VUL: In diébus illis , et in témpore illo , ait Dóminus :
traditions.KJV: In those days , and in that time , saith the LORD ,
traditions.DSS: ו ב עת (^ ה## ה#יא ^) {{ ה## ה##מ##ה# }} נאמ יהוה

4.english_reference: the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together ,

traditions.WLC: יָבֹ֧אוּ בְנֵֽי יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הֵ֥מָּה וּ בְנֵֽי יְהוּדָ֖ה יַחְדָּ֑ו
traditions.VUL: vénient fílii Israel , ipsi et fílii Iuda simul :
traditions.KJV: the children of Israel shall come , they and the children of Judah together ,
traditions.DSS: [ יבאו בני ישראל המה ו בני יהודה יחדו

4.english_reference: going and weeping : they shall go ,

traditions.KJV: going and weeping : they shall go ,

4.english_reference: and seek the LORD their God .

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵי הֶ֖ם יְבַקֵּֽשׁוּ
traditions.KJV: and seek the LORD their God .

5.english_reference: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward ,

traditions.WLC: צִיּ֣וֹן יִשְׁאָ֔לוּ דֶּ֖רֶךְ הֵ֣נָּה פְנֵי הֶ֑ם
traditions.VUL: In Sion interrogábunt viam , huc fácies eórum :
traditions.KJV: They shall ask the way to Zion with their faces thitherward , [ saying ] ,

5.english_reference: [ saying ] , Come , and let us join ourselves to the LORD

traditions.KJV: Come , and let us join ourselves to the LORD

5.english_reference: in a perpetual covenant [ that ] shall not be forgotten .

traditions.VUL: fœ́dere sempitérno , quod nulla oblivióne delébitur .
traditions.KJV: in a perpetual covenant [ that ] shall not be forgotten .

6.english_reference: My people hath been lost sheep :

traditions.VUL: Grex pérditus factus est pópulus meus :
traditions.KJV: My people hath been lost sheep :

6.english_reference: their shepherds have caused them to go astray , they have turned them away [ on ] the mountains :

traditions.WLC: רֹעֵי הֶ֣ם הִתְע֔וּ ם הָרִ֖ים שובבים
traditions.VUL: pastóres eórum seduxérunt eos , fecerúntque vagári in móntibus :
traditions.KJV: their shepherds have caused them to go astray , they have turned them away [ on ] the mountains :

6.english_reference: they have gone from mountain to hill ,

traditions.KJV: they have gone from mountain to hill ,
traditions.DSS: מ# הר [ א ]ל גב##ע##[ ה הלכו

traditions.KJV: they have forgotten their restingplace .

7.english_reference: All that found them have devoured them :

traditions.KJV: All that found them have devoured them :

7.english_reference: and their adversaries said , We offend not ,

traditions.WLC: וְ צָרֵי הֶ֥ם אָמְר֖וּ לֹ֣א נֶאְשָׁ֑ם
traditions.VUL: et hostes eórum dixérunt : Non peccávimus :
traditions.KJV: and their adversaries said , We offend not ,

7.english_reference: because they have sinned against the LORD , the habitation of justice ,

traditions.WLC: תַּ֗חַת אֲשֶׁ֨ר חָטְא֤וּ לַֽ יהוָה֙ נְוֵה צֶ֔דֶק
traditions.VUL: pro eo quod peccavérunt Dómino decóri iustítiæ ,
traditions.KJV: because they have sinned against the LORD , the habitation of justice ,

7.english_reference: even the LORD , the hope of their fathers .

traditions.KJV: even the LORD , the hope of their fathers .

8.english_reference: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans ,

traditions.WLC: נֻ֚דוּ מִ תּ֣וֹךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וּ מֵ אֶ֥רֶץ כַּשְׂדִּ֖ים יצאו
traditions.VUL: Recédite de médio Babylónis , et de terra Chaldæórum egredímini :
traditions.KJV: Remove out of the midst of Babylon , and go forth out of the land of the Chaldeans ,

8.english_reference: and be as the he goats before the flocks .

traditions.WLC: וִ הְי֕וּ כְּ עַתּוּדִ֖ים לִ פְנֵי צֹֽאן
traditions.VUL: et estóte quasi hædi ante gregem .
traditions.KJV: and be as the he goats before the flocks .

9.english_reference: For , lo , I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country :

traditions.WLC: כִּ֣י הִנֵּ֣ה אָנֹכִ֡י מֵעִיר֩ וּ מַעֲלֶ֨ה עַל בָּבֶ֜ל קְהַל גּוֹיִ֤ם גְּדֹלִים֙ מֵ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן
traditions.VUL: Quóniam ecce ego súscito , et addúcam in Babylónem congregatiónem géntium magnárum de terra aquilónis :
traditions.KJV: For , lo , I will raise and cause to come up against Babylon an assembly of great nations from the north country :

9.english_reference: and they shall set themselves in array against her ; from thence she shall be taken :

traditions.WLC: וְ עָ֣רְכוּ לָ֔ הּ מִ שָּׁ֖ם תִּלָּכֵ֑ד
traditions.VUL: et præparabúntur advérsus eam , et inde capiétur :
traditions.KJV: and they shall set themselves in array against her ; from thence she shall be taken :

9.english_reference: their arrows [ shall be ] as of a mighty expert man ;

traditions.VUL: sagítta eius quasi viri fortis interfectóris ,
traditions.KJV: their arrows [ shall be ] as of a mighty expert man ;
none shall return in vain .

10.english_reference: And Chaldea shall be a spoil :

traditions.KJV: And Chaldea shall be a spoil :

10.english_reference: all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the LORD .

traditions.WLC: כָּל שֹׁלְלֶ֥י הָ יִשְׂבָּ֖עוּ נְאֻם יְהוָֽה
traditions.VUL: omnes vastántes eam replebúntur , ait Dóminus .
traditions.KJV: all that spoil her shall be satisfied , saith the LORD .

11.english_reference: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced

traditions.KJV: Because ye were glad , because ye rejoiced ,

11.english_reference: O ye destroyers of mine heritage

traditions.KJV: O ye destroyers of mine heritage ,

11.english_reference: because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls

traditions.WLC: כִּ֤י תפושי כְּ עֶגְלָ֣ה דָשָׁ֔ה ו תצהלי כָּ אֲבִּרִֽים
traditions.VUL: quóniam effúsi estis sicut vítuli super herbam , et mugístis sicut tauri .
traditions.KJV: because ye are grown fat as the heifer at grass , and bellow as bulls ;

12.english_reference: Your mother shall be sore confounded

traditions.KJV: Your mother shall be sore confounded ;

12.english_reference: she that bare you shall be ashamed

traditions.VUL: et adæquáta púlveri , quæ génuit vos :
traditions.KJV: she that bare you shall be ashamed :

12.english_reference: behold , the hindermost of the nations [ shall be ] a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert

traditions.WLC: הִנֵּה֙ אַחֲרִ֣ית גּוֹיִ֔ם מִדְבָּ֖ר צִיָּ֥ה וַ עֲרָבָֽה
traditions.VUL: ecce novíssima erit in géntibus , desérta , ínvia , et arens .
traditions.KJV: behold , the hindermost of the nations [ shall be ] a wilderness , a dry land , and a desert .

13.english_reference: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited

traditions.KJV: Because of the wrath of the LORD it shall not be inhabited ,

13.english_reference: but it shall be wholly desolate

traditions.KJV: but it shall be wholly desolate :

13.english_reference: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues

traditions.WLC: כֹּ֚ל עֹבֵ֣ר עַל בָּבֶ֔ל יִשֹּׁ֥ם וְ יִשְׁרֹ֖ק עַל כָּל מַכּוֹתֶֽי הָ
traditions.VUL: omnis qui transíbit per Babylónem , stupébit , et sibilábit super univérsis plagis eius .
traditions.KJV: every one that goeth by Babylon shall be astonished , and hiss at all her plagues .

14.english_reference: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about

traditions.KJV: Put yourselves in array against Babylon round about :

14.english_reference: all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her

traditions.WLC: כָּל דֹּ֣רְכֵי קֶ֔שֶׁת יְד֣וּ אֵלֶ֔י הָ
traditions.VUL: omnes qui ténditis arcum : debelláte eam ,
traditions.KJV: all ye that bend the bow , shoot at her ,
spare no arrows :

14.english_reference: for she hath sinned against the LORD

traditions.KJV: for she hath sinned against the LORD .
Shout against her round about :
she hath given her hand :
her foundations are fallen ,
her walls are thrown down :

15.english_reference: for it [ is ] the vengeance of the LORD

traditions.KJV: for it [ is ] the vengeance of the LORD :

15.english_reference: take vengeance upon her ; as she hath done , do unto her

traditions.WLC: הִנָּ֣קְמוּ בָ֔ הּ כַּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשְׂתָ֖ה עֲשׂוּ לָֽ הּ
traditions.VUL: ultiónem accípite de ea : sicut fecit , fácite ei .
traditions.KJV: take vengeance upon her ; as she hath done , do unto her .

16.english_reference: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest

traditions.WLC: כִּרְת֤וּ זוֹרֵ֨עַ֙ מִ בָּבֶ֔ל וְ תֹפֵ֥שׂ מַגָּ֖ל בְּ עֵ֣ת קָצִ֑יר
traditions.VUL: Dispérdite satórem de Babylóne , et tenéntem falcem in témpore messis :
traditions.KJV: Cut off the sower from Babylon , and him that handleth the sickle in the time of harvest :

16.english_reference: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people

traditions.WLC: מִ פְּנֵי֙ חֶ֣רֶב הַ יּוֹנָ֔ה אִ֤ישׁ אֶל עַמּ וֹ֙ יִפְנ֔וּ
traditions.VUL: a fácie gládii colúmbæ unusquísque ad pópulum suum convertétur ,
traditions.KJV: for fear of the oppressing sword they shall turn every one to his people ,

16.english_reference: and they shall flee every one to his own land

traditions.WLC: וְ אִ֥ישׁ לְ אַרְצ֖ וֹ יָנֻֽסוּ
traditions.VUL: et sínguli ad terram suam fúgient .
traditions.KJV: and they shall flee every one to his own land .

17.english_reference: Israel [ is ] a scattered sheep ; the lions have driven [ him ] away

traditions.WLC: שֶׂ֧ה פְזוּרָ֛ה יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֲרָי֣וֹת הִדִּ֑יחוּ הָ
traditions.VUL: Grex dispérsus Israel , leónes eiecérunt eum :
traditions.KJV: Israel [ is ] a scattered sheep ; the lions have driven [ him ] away :

17.english_reference: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him

traditions.KJV: first the king of Assyria hath devoured him ;

17.english_reference: and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones

traditions.WLC: וְ זֶ֤ה הָ אַחֲרוֹן֙ עִצְּמ֔ וֹ נְבוּכַדְרֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶֽל
traditions.VUL: iste novíssimus exossávit eum Nabuchodónosor rex Babylónis .
traditions.KJV: and last this Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon hath broken his bones .

18.english_reference: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel

traditions.WLC: לָ כֵ֗ן כֹּֽה אָמַ֞ר יְהוָ֤ה צְבָאוֹת֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Proptérea hæc dicit Dóminus exercítuum , Deus Israel :
traditions.KJV: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts , the God of Israel ;

18.english_reference: Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land

traditions.WLC: הִנְ נִ֥י פֹקֵ֛ד אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְ אֶל אַרְצ֑ וֹ
traditions.VUL: Ecce ego visitábo regem Babylónis et terram eius ,
traditions.KJV: Behold , I will punish the king of Babylon and his land ,

18.english_reference: as I have punished the king of Assyria

traditions.WLC: כַּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּקַ֖דְתִּי אֶל מֶ֥לֶךְ אַשּֽׁוּר
traditions.KJV: as I have punished the king of Assyria .

19.english_reference: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation

traditions.WLC: וְ שֹׁבַבְתִּ֤י אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל נָוֵ֔ הוּ
traditions.VUL: et redúcam Israel ad habitáculum suum :
traditions.KJV: And I will bring Israel again to his habitation ,

19.english_reference: and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan

traditions.WLC: וְ רָעָ֥ה הַ כַּרְמֶ֖ל וְ הַ בָּשָׁ֑ן
traditions.KJV: and he shall feed on Carmel and Bashan ,

19.english_reference: and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead

traditions.WLC: וּ בְ הַ֥ר אֶפְרַ֛יִם וְ הַ גִּלְעָ֖ד תִּשְׂבַּ֥ע נַפְשֽׁ וֹ
traditions.VUL: et in monte Ephraim , et Gálaad saturábitur ánima eius .
traditions.KJV: and his soul shall be satisfied upon mount Ephraim and Gilead .

20.english_reference: In those days , and in that time , saith the LORD

traditions.WLC: בַּ יָּמִ֣ים הָ הֵם֩ וּ בָ עֵ֨ת הַ הִ֜יא נְאֻם יְהוָ֗ה
traditions.VUL: In diébus illis , et in témpore illo , ait Dóminus ,
traditions.KJV: In those days , and in that time , saith the LORD ,

20.english_reference: the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and [ there shall be ] none

traditions.WLC: יְבֻקַּ֞שׁ אֶת עֲוֺ֤ן יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וְ אֵינֶ֔ נּוּ
traditions.VUL: quærétur iníquitas Israel , et non erit :
traditions.KJV: the iniquity of Israel shall be sought for , and [ there shall be ] none ;

20.english_reference: and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found

traditions.WLC: וְ אֶת חַטֹּ֥את יְהוּדָ֖ה וְ לֹ֣א תִמָּצֶ֑אינָה
traditions.VUL: et peccátum Iuda , et non inveniétur :
traditions.KJV: and the sins of Judah , and they shall not be found :

20.english_reference: for I will pardon them whom I reserve

traditions.VUL: quóniam propítius ero eis quos relíquero .
traditions.KJV: for I will pardon them whom I reserve .

21.english_reference: Go up against the land of Merathaim , [ even ] against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod

traditions.WLC: עַל הָ אָ֤רֶץ מְרָתַ֨יִם֙ עֲלֵ֣ה עָלֶ֔י הָ וְ אֶל יוֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּק֑וֹד
traditions.VUL: Super terram dominántium ascénde , et super habitatóres eius vísita ,
traditions.KJV: Go up against the land of Merathaim , [ even ] against it , and against the inhabitants of Pekod :

21.english_reference: waste and utterly destroy after them

traditions.VUL: díssipa , et intérfice quæ post eos sunt ,
traditions.KJV: waste and utterly destroy after them ,
saith the LORD ,

21.english_reference: and do according to all that I have commanded thee

traditions.WLC: וַ עֲשֵׂ֕ה כְּ כֹ֖ל אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽי ךָ
traditions.VUL: et fac iuxta ómnia quæ præcépi tibi .
traditions.KJV: and do according to all that I have commanded thee .

22.english_reference: A sound of battle [ is ] in the land

traditions.KJV: A sound of battle [ is ] in the land ,
and of great destruction .

23.english_reference: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken !

traditions.WLC: אֵ֤יךְ נִגְדַּע֙ וַ יִּשָּׁבֵ֔ר פַּטִּ֖ישׁ כָּל הָ אָ֑רֶץ
traditions.VUL: Quómodo confráctus est , et contrítus málleus univérsæ terræ ?
traditions.KJV: How is the hammer of the whole earth cut asunder and broken !

23.english_reference: how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !

traditions.WLC: אֵ֣יךְ הָיְתָ֧ה לְ שַׁמָּ֛ה בָּבֶ֖ל בַּ גּוֹיִֽם
traditions.VUL: quómodo versa est in desértum Bábylon in géntibus ?
traditions.KJV: how is Babylon become a desolation among the nations !

24.english_reference: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon

traditions.WLC: יָקֹ֨שְׁתִּי לָ֤ ךְ וְ גַם נִלְכַּדְתְּ֙ בָּבֶ֔ל
traditions.VUL: Illaqueávi te , et capta es Bábylon ,
traditions.KJV: I have laid a snare for thee , and thou art also taken , O Babylon ,
and thou wast not aware :

24.english_reference: thou art found , and also caught

traditions.KJV: thou art found , and also caught ,

24.english_reference: because thou hast striven against the LORD

traditions.KJV: because thou hast striven against the LORD .

25.english_reference: The LORD hath opened his armoury

traditions.KJV: The LORD hath opened his armoury ,

25.english_reference: and hath brought forth the weapons of his indignation

traditions.WLC: וַ יּוֹצֵ֖א אֶת כְּלֵ֣י זַעְמ֑ וֹ
